children.value:
This site, and the three applications of our shadcn/ui port, are TanStack
Start apps — this page is the setup they use.

The packages are packed and install-tested on every change, but not published.
Until they are, install them from tarballs as

properties.html: import kirana from "@kirana-style/vite" import { tanstackStart } from "@tanstack/react-start/plugin/vite" import viteReact from "@vitejs/plugin-react" import { defineConfig } from "vite" export default defineConfig({ // Kirana ahead of the framework plugins, so modules reach them compiled; route // splitting re-emits modules under a query, and those are compiled too. plugins: [kirana(), tanstackStart(), viteReact()], })

children.value: Two things belong at the root: the stylesheets, in order, and the colour scheme.

properties.html: import kiranaCss from "@kirana-style/core/stylesheet.css?url" import appCss from "./globals.css?url" export const Route = createRootRoute({ head: () => ({ links: [ // First: its `@layer` statement fixes the layer order before your CSS // opens the reset and base layers. { rel: "stylesheet", href: kiranaCss }, { rel: "stylesheet", href: appCss }, ], }), shellComponent: RootDocument, }) function RootDocument({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) { return ( <html lang="en" sx={mode.system}> <head> <HeadContent /> </head> <body sx={styles.body}>{children}</body> </html> ) }

: the root owns the page canvas and
the scrollbars.

There is nothing to do. Styles are in a stylesheet the document links, and class
names are in the markup, so server-rendered HTML is already styled — no style
collection step, no flash, no double render.

Server components work the same way: the compiler runs at build time, so nothing
of Kirana has to run on the server at request time.
